claim.claim-text: 1. An integrated circuit for controlling a user equipment, the integrated circuit comprising:

receiving circuitry, which is configured to receive a minimum-system-information message from a first radio base station controlling a first radio cell of a mobile communication system, wherein system information for the first radio cell that can be acquired by the user equipment is carried within the minimum-system-information message and one or more additional-system-information messages, the minimum-system-information message including system information for accessing the first radio cell and including at least one system information index, each system information index being associated with one of the additional-system-information messages, wherein the system information index comprises a value tag and an area pointer, the area pointer pointing to one area already defined, processing circuitry, which is configured to determine whether the user equipment had already acquired before the additional-system-information message being associated with the same value tag and the same area as indicated by the system information index received in the minimum-system-information message, and if the determination is positive, the processing circuitry is configured to determine that system information included in said additional-system-information message acquired before is applicable to the first radio cell, wherein an area type list is stored in the user equipment, wherein each item in the area type list is associated with a list number and an area type, wherein the area pointer indicates a list number of the area type list, wherein the processing circuitry is configured to determine the area type based on the area pointer and the area type list and to determine an area identification based on the determined area type and a previously acquired area identification for said determined area type, wherein the processing circuitry is configured to determine whether the additional-system-information message acquired before is applicable for the same area based on the determined area type and determined area identification.

2. The integrated circuit according to claim 1, wherein if the determination is negative, the processing circuitry is configured to determine that system information included in said additional-system-information message acquired before is not applicable to the first radio cell, and to determine to acquire the additional-system-information message for the first radio cell from the first radio base station.
3. The integrated circuit according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the area type is one of the following:
∘ a tracking area, ∘ a radio access network, RAN,-based notification area, ∘ a closed subscriber group area, ∘ a radio cell, ∘ a system information area.

4. The integrated circuit according to one of claims 1 to 3, wherein the receiving circuitry is configured to receive a second minimum-system-information message from the first radio base station of the first radio cell, the second minimum-system-information message including system information for accessing the first radio cell and including one extended system information index, the extended system information index being associated with one of the additional-system-information messages,

wherein the extended system information index comprises a value tag and an identification of a system information area, wherein the processing circuitry is configured to determine whether the user equipment had already acquired before the additional-system-information message being associated with the same value tag and the same system information area as included in the extended system information index, and if said determination is positive, the processing circuitry is configured to determine that system information included in said additional-system-information message acquired before is applicable to the first radio cell.

5. The integrated circuit according to any of claims 1 to 4 wherein the processing circuitry is configured to store the received value tag of the system information index and information on the area indicated by the area pointer of the system information index in association with the associated additional-system-information message, optionally wherein the stored information on the area comprises information on the type of the indicated area and on the identification of the indicated area.

6. The integrated circuit according to any of claims 1 to 5, wherein the receiving circuitry is configured to receive a third minimum-system-information message from the first radio base station of the first radio cell, the third minimum-system-information message including system information for accessing the first radio cell and including a third system information index, the third system information index being associated with an additional-system-information message that the user equipment has already acquired before,

wherein the processing circuitry is configured to determine that content of the previously acquired system information message has changed when determining that the value of the value tag associated with the previously acquired additional-system-information message is different from the value of a value tag included in the third system information index of the minimum-system-information message, wherein the processing circuitry is configured to determine to re-acquire the additional-system-information message when determining that the content of the previously acquired additional-system-information message has changed.

7. The integrated circuit according to any of claims 1 to 6, wherein the additional system information message already acquired before was received by the receiving circuitry of the user equipment when the user equipment was located in a different radio cell or in the first radio cell.

8. The integrated circuit according to any of claims 1 to 7, wherein the user equipment is moving to a second radio cell under control of a second radio base station, wherein the receiving circuitry is configured to receive from the first radio base station at least one system information index associated with one additional-system-information message that the user equipment is able to acquire in the second radio cell upon requesting same,

wherein transmitting circuitry is configured to transmit to the second radio base station a request for acquiring the one additional-system-information message indicated in the system information index that is associated with the second radio cell, optionally wherein the request is transmitted by the transmitting circuitry in a message of a random access channel procedure performed between the user equipment and the second radio base station when moving to the second radio base station optionally wherein the receiving circuitry is configured to receive from the second radio base station the requested additional-system-information message in a message of the random access channel procedure, subsequent to the message used for transmitting the request.

9. The integrated circuit according to claim 1 to 7, wherein the user equipment is moving to a second radio cell under control of a second radio base station, wherein at least one additional-system-information message that the user equipment is able to acquire in the second radio cell is available upon requesting same, wherein the receiving circuitry is configured to receive the additional-system-information message from the second radio base station in a message of the random access channel procedure.
